brief: CEO wants a full website redesign by Monday. Sam is the only frontend dev.
brief_id: CEO minta redesign website sebelum Senin. Sam satu-satunya frontend dev.

scenes.text:
Friday, 3:47 PM.

The CEO just posted in the engineering channel.
Full website redesign. By Monday.

One frontend dev on the team.
That's Sam.

id.text:
Jumat, 15:47.

CEO baru saja posting di channel engineering.
Redesign website. Sebelum Senin.

Satu frontend dev di tim.
Itu Sam.

scenes.text:
Taylor. TAYLOR.

Did you see the Slack? The CEO wants the company website redesigned. By Monday. I'm the only frontend dev on this. I haven't touched the code in two years.

id.text:
Taylor. TAYLOR.

Kamu lihat Slack-nya? CEO minta website perusahaan didesain ulang. Sebelum Senin. Aku satu-satunya frontend dev di sini. Codingannya itu nggak pernah aku sentuh dua tahun terakhir.

scenes.text: I saw it. How bad is the current site?

id.text: Udah lihat. Separah apa sih situsnya?

scenes.text:
It looks like a website from 2009. Plain white, ugly fonts, breaks on every phone.

The CEO called it "embarrassing."

In the Slack channel. To the whole company.

id.text:
Tampilannya kayak website tahun 2009. Putih polos, font jelek, berantakan di semua HP.

CEO nyebutnya "memalukan."

Di channel Slack. Ke seluruh perusahaan.

scenes.text: Okay. Before you spiral — have you tried Bob?

id.text: Oke. Sebelum kamu panik — udah coba Bob belum?

scenes.text: Bob. The AI thing IT rolled out last month?

id.text: Bob. Itu tool AI yang IT deploy bulan lalu?

scenes.text:
It's not just an AI thing.
I used it last week to audit our entire infrastructure config. It found three misconfigurations I'd been missing for months.

Just open it. Tell it your problem. Exactly like you told me.

id.text:
Bukan sekadar tool AI. Minggu lalu aku pakai buat audit seluruh config infrastruktur. Nemu tiga konfigurasi salah yang sudah aku lewatkan berbulan-bulan.

Buka aja. Ceritakan masalahmu. Persis seperti kamu cerita ke aku.

scenes.text: He will deliver. Just open Bob!

Fine. If this doesn't work I'm blaming you.

...Okay. Opening it now.

id.text:
Baiklah. Kalau nggak berhasil, aku salahkan kamu.

...Oke. Lagi dibuka.

scenes.text:
Sam opens IBM Bob inside VS Code.
For the first time.

id.text:
Sam membuka IBM Bob di dalam VS Code.
Untuk pertama kalinya.

scenes.text:
Friday, 6:08 PM.
Sam closes the Bob chat window.

id.text:
Jumat, 18:08.
Sam menutup jendela chat Bob.

scenes.text:
Taylor. It's done.

New site. Fully checked. Report ready for the CEO.

Two hours.

id.text:
Taylor. Selesai.

Situs baru. Sudah dicek semua. Laporan siap buat CEO.

Dua jam.

scenes.text: That would've been your whole weekend.

id.text: Itu harusnya makan seluruh akhir pekanmu.

scenes.text:
Easily. And I would've missed half the problems.

Bob caught everything before touching a single file.

id.text:
Mudah. Dan aku pasti melewatkan setengah masalahnya.

Bob nemuin semuanya sebelum menyentuh satu file pun.

scenes.text:
I'm going home at 6 PM on a Friday.

...Okay. You win. Bob is actually insane.

id.text:
Aku pulang jam 6 sore di hari Jumat.

...Oke. Kamu menang. Bob benar-benar luar biasa.

scenes.text:
It doesn't replace you.

It just stops wasting your time.

id.text:
Bob nggak gantiin kamu.

Bob cuma berhentiin hal-hal yang buang waktumu.

scenes.text:
Audit done.
Redesign shipped.
Report in the CEO's hands.

Friday evening.
Not Sunday night.

That's what Bob is for.

id.text:
Audit selesai.
Redesign terkirim.
Laporan sudah di tangan CEO.

Jumat sore.
Bukan Minggu malam.

Itulah kegunaan Bob.

scenes.text:
Sam Rivera shipped the redesign at 6:12 PM on Friday.
The CEO called it "a massive improvement" on Monday morning.

Time saved: ~6 hours.

id.text:
Sam Rivera mengirimkan redesign pukul 18:12 hari Jumat.
CEO menyebutnya "peningkatan besar" pada Senin pagi.

Waktu yang dihemat: ~6 jam.
